original_datasets.name: RiskData
original_datasets.notes: Analyst excludes participants with age == 99. Risk task variables are in wide format (Risk1x=PV, Risk2x=RV, Risk3x=LV). In LV, the first four trials are flipped before scoring. Dataset must be available at /app/data/RiskData.dta for execution.

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Import the original RiskData, exclude age==99, reshape to long, label PV/RV/LV blocks, assign within-block trial numbers, flip LV trials 1–4, convert choices to numeric, sum PV and RV risky choices, average to create RiskAversion, sum LV optimal choices as LV_Perform, regress LV_Perform on RiskAversion; also compute Spearman correlation as robustness.
preprocessing_steps: Reshape wide Risk1x, Risk2x, Risk3x columns to long.
Label Condition as PV (Risk1x), RV (Risk2x), LV (Risk3x).
Create within-ID and within-Condition trial numbers (1–10).
Flip LV choices for trials 1–4 (1->0, 0->1); then cast to numeric.
Aggregate per ID: PV_Risk=sum(PV choices), RV_Risk=sum(RV choices), LV_Perform=sum(LV choices).
Compute Spearman correlation between LV_Perform and RiskAversion.

key_choices.outcome_measure: LV_Perform: sum of optimal LV decisions after flipping trials 1–4.
key_choices.main_predictor_measure: RiskAversion: average of PV_Risk and RV_Risk (sums of risky choices).
key_choices.missing_data_rule: Propagate missing values; rows with NA in LV_Perform or RiskAversion dropped before regression.
key_choices.data_processing: Wide-to-long reshape; label tasks; per-ID sums; compute trial indices and LV flip; numeric conversion.
key_choices.inference_rule: p-value from regression coefficient (and model F-test) to judge support.

outcome.name: LV_Perform
outcome.definition: Per-participant sum of optimal LV choices after flipping first four LV trials.

main_predictor.name: RiskAversion
main_predictor.definition: Average of PV_Risk and RV_Risk; each is the per-participant sum of risky choices in PV and RV tasks.

analysis_code.notes: Script reads /app/data/RiskData.dta, performs preprocessing, OLS regression, and outputs JSON including coefficients, F-stat, adjusted R^2, and Spearman correlation.

codebase.notes: Both scripts expect the original dataset at /app/data/RiskData.dta. They rely on pandas, numpy, pyreadstat, statsmodels, and scipy. Entry files are set per task.

analysis.instructions: Execute Task1 and Task2 using the original dataset RiskData.dta, run the provided Python entry scripts, and capture JSON outputs including regression coefficients, test statistics, and fit metrics.

debugging_rule.repair_scope: fix dependency, file path, or output extraction issues only; do not redesign the analysis.

analysis.comparison_metrics: Regression coefficient for RiskAversion (estimate, SE, t, p), model F-statistic and p-value, adjusted R^2; for Task1 also Spearman rho and p-value.
